# Micah 1 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 1:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For behold, YHWH is-going-forth from-His-place, and-He-will-come-down and-tread upon-the-high-places-of the-earth. |
| LOGOS | For behold, the LORD is coming out of His place, and will come down and tread upon the high places of the earth. |
| PNEUMA | Look! The LORD is coming! He leaves His throne in heaven and tramples the heights of the earth. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-mountains will-melt under-Him, and-the-valleys will-split-open, like-wax before the-fire, like-waters poured-down a-steep-place. |
| LOGOS | And the mountains will melt under Him, and the valleys will split open, like wax before the fire, like waters poured down a steep place. |
| PNEUMA | The mountains melt beneath His feet and the valleys split apart, like wax too close to a flame, like water cascading down a hillside. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:7 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-all her-carved-images will-be-beaten-to-pieces, and-all her-wages will-be-burned with-fire, and-all her-idols I-will-make a-desolation; for from-[the]-wages-of a-prostitute she-gathered-[them], and-to [the]-wages-of a-prostitute they-will-return." |
| LOGOS | All her carved images shall be beaten to pieces, all her wages shall be burned with fire, and all her idols I will lay waste, for from the fee of a prostitute she gathered them, and to the fee of a prostitute they shall return." |
| PNEUMA | All her carved idols will be smashed. All the wages she earned from prostitution will be burned up. I will destroy every idol, because she collected them through prostitution, and to prostitution they will return." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-Gath do-not-tell-[it]; weeping do-not-weep! In-Beth-le-Aphrah roll-yourself in-the-dust. |
| LOGOS | Tell it not in Gath; weep not at all; in Beth-le-aphrah roll yourselves in the dust. |
| PNEUMA | Don't announce it in Gath! Don't even weep! In Beth-le-aphrah, roll in the dust in mourning. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:6 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "And-I-will-make Samaria a-heap-of-ruins in-the-field, planting-places for-a-vineyard; and-I-will-pour-down her-stones into-the-valley, and-her-foundations I-will-uncover. |
| LOGOS | "Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of ruins in the open country, a place for planting vineyards, and I will pour down her stones into the valley and uncover her foundations. |
| PNEUMA | "So I will make Samaria a heap of rubble — an empty field for planting vineyards. I will roll her stones down into the valley and strip her down to her bare foundations. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 1:2 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Hear, peoples, all-of-you! Give-attention, O-earth and-its-fullness! And-let-the-Lord YHWH be against-you for-a-witness — the-Lord from-His-holy temple. |
| LOGOS | Hear, all you peoples! Pay attention, O earth and all that is in it, and let the Lord GOD be a witness against you, the Lord from His holy temple. |
| PNEUMA | Listen, all you people! Pay attention, earth and everyone in it! The Sovereign LORD is making accusations against you from His holy Temple. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---
